items.title: No credit card required for trial
items.desc: Free trial for up to 7 days or 150 AI replies, whichever comes first. No credit card is required. Charges require explicit agreement to a subscription.

items.title: One-click cancellation anytime
items.desc: No multi-year lock-ins. Cancel anytime directly from your dashboard settings.

items.title: Official Meta Cloud API included
items.desc: Official connection via Meta Cloud API: minimizes the risk of account bans compared to unofficial tools.

items.q: How is the monthly allowance expressed?
items.a: Your monthly allowance counts validated AI replies. You can view usage in the dashboard.

items.q: What happens when I reach my plan's message limit?
items.a: The AI assistant stops sending new automated replies and requests are passed to a human operator. You can upgrade your plan to increase the allowance.

items.q: Can I switch plans or cancel later?
items.a: Absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime through the Stripe billing portal integrated in your settings.
Meta WhatsApp fees are billed separately.
